description: 3 ops, scale=7.72e2, extrude(polygon,boss)+revolve(polygon,boss)+extrude(gear,symmetric) — prospector seed 1 index 19 RE-minimized 2026-09-30 (after P0005 converted; 6→3): square boss, 300° pentagon revolve (slender cone faces, half-angle 0.085 rad), 10-tooth module-111 gear symmetric boss on a plane 7.6° off the cone axis. Was a SILENT WRONG: watertight_mesh 6 unpaired edges (6 non-manifold, FOUR incident triangles each) — kernel-v2's boundary-only developable patch CDT clipped ears over three consecutive samples of a cone × flank ELLIPSE arc and used chords between two of them as interior diagonals; three points of a planar curve span a triangle IN that plane, so the cone's ear coincided with the gear flank's own ear and the chord survived as a diagonal of BOTH faces. CONVERTED 2026-09-30: the P0008 refinement criterion (tessellate/developable.rs) tags boundary nodes with their planar neighbor and splits any interior chart edge whose ends share one at its on-surface midpoint (pin tests/p0008_coplanar_neighbor_edge.rs, RED before).
